reject.reason: Inconsistent with the same decision's own keep: Pelton Basin and Cottonwood are kept as 'plausible Stehekin-side access', and Basin Creek Camp sits on that same Stehekin valley trail between them (at the Horseshoe Basin junction). Hurry-up's S Glacier drains into Trapper Lake (Wikipedia 'Hurry-up Peak'), and Trapper Mountain (0.7 mi east) keeps Basin Creek for exactly this valley approach. Either all three Stehekin-valley camps go or none; removing only the middle one is wrong.
